components.text:
Kyoto 3-Day Temple and Tea Itinerary (Oct 15-17, 2025)

Trip Context and Budget Guardrails
- Daily budget target: 15,000 JPY (food, transport, tickets; accommodation excluded).
- Pace: relaxed, with longer temple blocks and tea-house stops instead of packed hopping.
- Transport: mostly subway/JR plus short bus/taxi hops to avoid uphill fatigue.

Daily Plan by Time Block
| Day | 08:00-12:00 Morning | 12:00-17:00 Afternoon | 17:00-21:00 Evening | Daily Cost (JPY) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Day 1 (Oct 15) | Kiyomizu-dera + Sannenzaka walk | Kodai-ji + Yasaka area tea break | Gion lantern streets + kaiseki-lite dinner | 13,800 |
| Day 2 (Oct 16) | Fushimi Inari lower loop at low crowds | Tofuku-ji autumn garden + tea ceremony | Pontocho riverside dinner walk | 14,700 |
| Day 3 (Oct 17) | Arashiyama bamboo grove + Tenryu-ji | Okochi Sanso garden + matcha cafe | Nishiki Market grazing + early finish | 14,200 |

Reservation-First Tea Ceremony Options
Option 1: Camellia Tea Ceremony (Higashiyama) | English-guided, beginner friendly, central location | Typical fee: 3,000-4,500 JPY
Action: [Button: Book Camellia Session] https://tea-kyoto.com/

Option 2: Maikoya Kyoto | Kimono add-on, multiple session slots | Typical fee: 5,000-8,000 JPY
Action: [Button: Check Maikoya Availability] https://mai-ko.com/tour/tea-ceremony-kyoto/

Option 3: En Tea House (Gion area) | Quiet atmosphere and small groups | Typical fee: 3,500-6,000 JPY
Action: [Button: Compare Gion Tea Experiences] https://www.getyourguide.com/kyoto-l96826/tea-ceremony-tc111/

Transport Sequence for Low Walking Load
- Day 1: Kyoto Station -> Kiyomizu-Gojo (Keihan) + short taxi uphill.
- Day 2: JR Kyoto -> Inari (JR Nara line), then Inari -> Tofukuji by local train.
- Day 3: Kyoto -> Saga-Arashiyama (JR), then local taxi to return after sunset.

Images:
- Kiyomizu Temple Morning View: https://loremflickr.com/1200/800/kyoto,temple
- Gion Evening Street: https://loremflickr.com/1200/800/kyoto,gion
- Arashiyama Bamboo Path: https://loremflickr.com/1200/800/kyoto,bamboo

Icons:
- Transit: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Tea: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Map: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

Quick Actions
[Button: Open Kyoto City Transport Map] https://www2.city.kyoto.lg.jp/kotsu/webguide/en/
[Button: Check Temple Opening Hours] https://kyoto.travel/en/

Sources
- Kyoto Official Travel Guide: https://kyoto.travel/en/
- Japan Guide Kyoto: https://www.japan-guide.com/e/e2158.html

components.text:
15-Minute Chicken Broccoli Pepper Stir-Fry (Serves 2)

Cooking Plan and Timing
- Total active + cook time target: 15 minutes.
- Protein: chicken breast, thin sliced for fast sear.
- Sauce profile: savory soy, ginger, garlic with light gloss.

Ingredients Table
| Ingredient | Amount | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chicken breast | 300g | Slice thin against grain |
| Broccoli florets | 180g | Small florets for fast cook |
| Bell peppers | 1.5 medium | Mixed colors, thin strips |
| Garlic | 3 cloves | Minced |
| Fresh ginger | 2 tsp | Finely grated |
| Soy sauce | 3 tbsp | Base savory |
| Water | 3 tbsp | Sauce balance |
| Cornstarch | 1.5 tsp | Thickening |
| Sesame oil | 1 tsp | Finish aroma |
| Neutral oil | 1.5 tbsp | High-heat stir-fry |

Sauce Mix (Prepare First)
- Whisk soy sauce + water + cornstarch + ginger + garlic until smooth.

15-Minute Step Sequence
| Minute | Action |
| --- | --- |
| 0-2 | Heat wok/pan to high, add neutral oil. |
| 2-5 | Sear chicken until mostly opaque and lightly browned; remove. |
| 5-8 | Stir-fry broccoli + peppers with 2 tbsp water, cover 60 sec. |
| 8-11 | Return chicken, pour sauce, toss continuously until glossy. |
| 11-13 | Reduce heat, finish with sesame oil, taste and adjust salt. |
| 13-15 | Plate immediately over steamed rice or noodles. |

Optional Flavor Tweaks
Option 1: Spicy Finish | Add 1 tsp chili crisp at minute 12 | Best for heat lovers
Action: [Button: Chili Crisp Pairing Ideas] https://www.seriouseats.com/

Option 2: Lower Sodium Variant | Use low-sodium soy and add 1 tsp rice vinegar | Cleaner profile
Action: [Button: Sodium Reduction Tips] https://www.eatright.org/

- Chicken Stir Fry Bowl: https://loremflickr.com/1200/800/chicken,stirfry
- Prep Ingredients on Board: https://loremflickr.com/1200/800/cooking,ingredients

- Fire: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/fire.svg
- Bowl: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/egg-fried.svg
